{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the sales data with proper parsing of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the unique values in channel
print("Unique channels:", sales_df['channel'].unique())

# Check the distribution of customer_segment across channels
print("\nCustomer segment distribution by channel:")
print(sales_df.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Filter out refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute total revenue per channel
channel_revenue = completed_orders.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()

# Print results
print("\nTotal revenue by channel:")
print(channel_revenue)

# Identify the channel with the most revenue
max_channel = channel_revenue.idxmax()
max_revenue = channel_revenue.max()

print(f"\nChannel with the most revenue: {max_channel} with ${max_revenue:,.2f}")"}
